## Question 1

```{r}
# I used ChatISA to help me a lot, as a heads-up


if(require(rvest)==FALSE) install.packages("rvest")
if(require(xml2)==FALSE) install.packages("xml2")
if(require(purrr)==FALSE) install.packages("purrr")
if(require(tibble)==FALSE) install.packages("tibble")
if(require(dplyr)==FALSE) install.packages("dplyr")
if(require(stringr)==FALSE) install.packages("stringr")


clean_text <- function(node) {
  if (is.na(node)) return(NA_character_)
  contents  <- xml2::xml_contents(node)
  text_only <- contents[xml2::xml_type(contents) == "text"]
  text_only |> xml2::xml_text() |> paste(collapse = " ") |> stringr::str_squish()
}

get_department_data <- function(dept) {

  encoded_dept <- utils::URLencode(dept, reserved = TRUE)
  url <- paste0("https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/", encoded_dept, "/all")

  page <- rvest::read_html(url)

  rows <- page |> rvest::html_elements("table tr")
  rows <- rows[-1]  # drop header row

  purrr::map_dfr(rows, function(row) {
    name_link <- row |> rvest::html_element("td:nth-child(3) strong a")
    pos_node  <- row |> rvest::html_element("td:nth-child(3) i")

    tibble::tibble(
      department = row |> rvest::html_element("td:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2(),
      name       = clean_text(name_link),
      position   = clean_text(pos_node),
      website    = name_link |> rvest::html_attr("href")
    )
  })
}


departments <- c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information Systems & Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)


all_faculty <- purrr::map_dfr(departments, get_department_data)

# drop exact duplicate rows
fsb_faculty <- all_faculty |>
  dplyr::filter(department %in% departments) |>
  dplyr::distinct(department, name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::arrange(department, name)

fsb_faculty |>
  dplyr::count(department) |>
  print()

# Final answer
head(fsb_faculty)
```
